name: herdr-orchestration
description: Multi-pane agent orchestration for herdr. Routes user tasks through the pane that received them, delegates to idle sibling agent panes over a composer-safe transport, and substitutes a fallback agent when one is exhausted.

interface.longDescription: Route user tasks through configured herdr roles, select sibling panes by agent type and model for delegated work and independent reviews, and substitute a fallback when an entry is unavailable or exhausted.
defaultPrompt: Route this task through the appropriate herdr agents.
Delegate this to an idle sibling pane and report back.
Verify that this agent pane can be driven before delegating to it.
